text:
lee: forwarding a customer escalation — embeddings endpoint returning intermittent 400 dimension_mismatch and occasional 504s. Started ~2026-03-11 18:19 UTC. sample req id req_0a1b2c. Logs show 'expected_dim=1536 got_dim=1024' on ~8-12% of requests. They use dynamic batching with large max_batch_size. Can someone take this?

jasmin: assigning to eng-runtime. lee, can you add minimal repro + client sdk version?

noah: pinged. saw similar behavior in staging after dynbatch tuning last week. Could be coalescing/padding bug when requests cross max_batch_size boundaries. Need repro and traces.

lee: customer details: model text-embed-redwood-v2, SDK python 1.6. Config: dynamic_batching=on, max_batch_size=64. Typical mix = 1 large doc split into ~25 chunks + many short 128-token items. Repro snippet below (minimal):

lee: ```python
# minimal repro (multi-threaded)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., model='text-embed-redwood-v2')
def send_batch():
    big = ['A'*30000]  # gets split on client into ~25 frames
    shorts = ['hi'] * 40
    items = big + shorts
    resp = client.embeddings.create(input=items, max_batch_size=64)
    print(resp)
# spawn 40 threads concurrently
```

noah: I ran that locally with MAX_BATCH_SIZE=64 and dynbatch enabled — reproduced 400 with 'dimension_mismatch' at coalesce step. stack snippet: 'error concat: expected 1536 got 1024'. Looks like some requests are being coalesced with different effective dims (maybe model variant mismatch or early rejection).

maria: infra noticed queue length spike on shard-7 starting 18:19 UTC and a config canary changed batch_deadline_ms from 12->20 at 18:15. Also saw higher retry volume (billing-bot shows a couple of 401 bursts).

deploy-bot: canary rollout dynbatch-tuning v2026.03 applied at 18:15 UTC (batch_deadline_ms=20, max_batch_size_hard=256).

jasmin: do we also see auth/billing flakey calls? customer mentioned 401s causing client retries which might exacerbate coalescing windows.

billing-bot: brief 401 spike 18:18:55-18:20:05 local to region-us-east-1 — likely key rotation event.

lee: customer saw a few 401s but major issues are 400 dim mismatches and long tail latencies. They reported retries increasing concurrency.

noah: hypothesis: increasing batch_deadline_ms + larger max_batch_size allows more heterogeneous requests to be coalesced. If a request is retried/short-circuited (auth fail) or pinned to a model variant with different embed dim, the coalescer may be combining tensors without proper dim checks, causing a concat failure. That also explains tail spikes when one very long doc joins a batch of short ones.

noah: immediate mitigations I recommend:
- set per-tenant override max_batch_size=16 (or disable dynbatch) for the affected customer
- rollback batch_deadline_ms to 12 on the affected shards
- enable stricter enqueue-time dim verification (short-term guard)

maria: rolling back batch_deadline_ms to 12 on shard-7 now. ETA ~5–10m.

noah: repro steps for eng: 1) set REDWOOD_DYNBATCH=1, MAX_BATCH_SIZE=64, spawn 40 concurrent threads using the snippet above, 2) watch logs for 'dimension_mismatch' in coalescer. I attached local trace ids in GH issue INF-3421.

noah: quick patch idea: reject at enqueue if input dimension metadata doesn't match batch head, rather than attempting concat. That will surface 400 earlier to caller and avoid crashing the coalescer.

deploy-bot: rollback complete on shard-7 at 18:46 UTC.

jasmin: created support P1 ticket INF-3421, tagging eng-runtime and infra. lee — can you offer the customer a per-tenant override and ask them to test after rollback?

lee: will send steps to customer now (disable dynbatch or set max_batch_size=16) and ask for traffic test. Also collecting client logs/trace ids.

jasmin: thanks team :thumbsup: noah/maria please follow up with a brief RCA once INF-3421 has more data.

noah: I opened GH INF-3421 with logs, repro, and a small unit test reproducer. Next steps: add enqueue dim guard + e2e test for mixed-length coalescing, and check key-rotation retry interactions.

lee: customer notified, they will verify in 30m and report back.

maria: monitoring alerts cleared on shard-7 after rollback.

jasmin: closing interim loop here — will keep thread updated when RCA is ready.
